process_model.Python_role: Own the launcher process only; outer wait4/Popen PID is a supervisory identity, never the actual science target RSS.
process_model.launcher_role: One separately execed single-threaded native C launcher per science/fixture invocation, bounded setup then exactly one ordinary fork and execve of registered target argv.
allowed_creation: that child execve exact registered native ELF or pinned host QEMU plus pinned guest ELF
forbidden_creation_alternatives: shell or PATH search for target
process_model.wait_owner: Native launcher wait4(fork-returned child PID,...) through exit; retain returned PID, raw wait status and complete rusage. Python separately reaps the launcher.
process_model.exec_error_channel: A separate CLOEXEC error pipe reports execve errno; EOF is necessary but not sufficient for target success. ENTRY/RETURN and full output/exit must independently hold.
process_model.process_identity: Use positive PID plus raw /proc stat start_ticks and namespace vectors; same three checkpoints for one invocation have the identical process key and PPid=launcher. Reused integer PID in another lifetime is not the same process.
process_model.descriptor_boundary: Only registered protocol read/write descriptors intentionally survive target exec; exec-error descriptor closes on exec. No API/network/credential descriptor is inherited.
success_requires: expected actual image transition and identities

descendants.target_wait4_scope: Linux target lifetime with any accounted-for waited descendants; neither exclusive main-image peak nor concurrent process-tree sum.

process_model.threads: Preserve original /proc Threads observations. ASan/QEMU/runtime threading is included; do not infer absence of all transient threads from checkpoints.
process_model.timeout_cleanup: Stop launch admission, kill the registered invocation process group, reap owned launcher/child and retain raw statuses. Remaining stage time is not restarted; incomplete or late cleanup/seal cannot produce success.

wire.encoding: ASCII subset of UTF-8, compact JSON object plus exactly one LF

protocol.PREEXEC: Child samples getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) while still the forked launcher image, then records monotonic_ns, emits PREEXEC and blocks. Parent records full host proc status/stat/exe identity before ACK. Sample interval is bounded by recorded fork-before time and message monotonic_ns, not a claimed instantaneous peak time.
protocol.ENTRY: Thin private --wrap=main wrapper emits ENTRY and blocks before invoking unchanged __real_main(argc,argv). The parent reads host proc files while child is blocked and ACKs only after capture/validation.
protocol.RETURN: After unchanged original main returns, wrapper emits RETURN carrying original signed return code, blocks for parent capture/ACK, then returns the same code. Snapshot excludes later wrapper/runtime/destructor/atexit/sanitizer/emulator cleanup.
protocol.ACK: Bind matching phase, nonce, ordinal, actual child and launcher PIDs; one ACK per phase, no skipped/repeated/out-of-order records.
protocol.parent_observation: Use launcher host /proc/<actual-child-pid> only. Record capture start/end monotonic_ns, exact raw bytes and actual executable file hash/device/inode.
protocol.QEMU: Actual /proc exe at ENTRY/RETURN is the pinned host QEMU. The separately hashed guest ELF and exact QEMU -L sysroot argv remain explicit. Guest /proc is not measurement authority.
protocol.observation_window: Retain both post-exec checkpoints of the same PID/start/namespace/exe history, with source-reviewed no intervening exec; never reset current-mm counters.
protocol.measurement_cost: Shim, handshakes, proc acquisition and all process memory/wall overhead are retained. Original inner F0 call timers stay in unchanged original main; no timing/RSS overhead subtraction.

rss.VmHWM_accuracy: Linux proc accounting is approximate; current-mm window is not an exact physical peak, instantaneous working set or a physical-memory upper-bound guarantee.
rss.QEMU_claim: Host emulator plus guest/harness lifetime and host current-mm observations; never guest-only RSS or ARM-board RAM.
rss.Sanitized_claim: Includes original ASan/UBSan/LSan/runtime costs with leak detection preserved. Full frames followed by signal/nonzero exit remain rejected.

allowed_interpretations.return_HWM_greater_than_entry: Only reported current-mm high-water increased after ENTRY within validated same-image history.
allowed_interpretations.return_HWM_equal_to_final_wait4: That reported final value is also observed in an after-exec current-mm window; does not locate its first or exclusive origin.
allowed_interpretations.wait4_greater_than_observed_floor: Lifetime accounting exceeded an observed floor; this alone cannot locate that increase before/after exec.
allowed_interpretations.inconsistent_counters: Preserve as accounting observations; no repair, threshold change or forced equalization.

forbidden_claims: first/exclusive postexec peak from equality alone
complete dynamic stack or heap peak
physical DUT/SSC305 RAM or timing qualification

Require exact PRE/POST selected ID/node/author/issue/timestamps/body bytes/SHA256 and actual source/event tuple stability. An already-open PR also needs the new synchronize event after freeze.
external_freeze.manual_repeat: No automatic retry. A later attempt needs a separate explicit root decision, keeps its separate cohort, and still requires source freeze predating the original run creation. Source approval alone does not authorize reruns.
external_freeze.trust_limit: Checkpoint observations and finite-precision provider timestamps do not prove no transient edit. No cryptographic comment immutability or hostile-runner guarantee. Trusted owner must not edit records; independent root source review and provider readback remain required.
